title: DomainSecurityPolicy
description: A domain security policy that defines access permissions for a specific Workday functional domain. Specifies which security groups can view or modify resources within the domain.

id.description: Unique identifier for the domain security policy

descriptor.description: Human-readable name of the domain security policy

domain.description: The Workday functional domain this policy governs

description.description: Detailed description of the policy and its scope

permissions.description: List of permission assignments defining which security groups have access and at what level

lastModified.description: Timestamp when the policy was last modified
